Given that NPV = PV – I and PI = PV / I, where PV is the present value of 
future net cash inflows and I is the initial investment on a project. Based 
on the data furnished above, which one of the following statements is 
correct? 
(A) 
Project A is recommended based on PI criterion 
(B) 
Project B is recommended based on NPV criterion 
(C) 
Project C is recommended based on PI criterion 
(D) 
Project A is recommended based on NPV criterion
suggested_answer: (A) Project A is recommended based on PI criterion Project A: PV = 15 + 60 = 75 Project B: PV = 20 + 100 = 120 Project C: PV = 25 + 150 = 175 PI = PV / I Project A: PI = 75/60 = 1.25 Project B: PI = 120/100 = 1.20 Project C: PI = 175/150 ≈ 1.167
